title: Interop contract
notes: The shared layout, adoption labels and the CLI Eli's tools drive. Both apps sit on the same seeded core layout; edits made through one app's CLI land in the shared document.

steps.name: adopt a labeled worker
steps.note: spawn-worker starts an agent labeled herdr.space/herdr.tab for a space nobody knows: it becomes a new space without taking focus.

steps.name: repos makes a space without focus
steps.note: repos: space.new {focus: false} keeps the shown space.

steps.name: Pi names its tab
steps.note: auto-session-name.ts: tab.rename from the tab's first Pi pane.
